decisions.statement: A line opens with the time in UTC to the millisecond.
A line the worker writes is a line the log reader parses back whole.
The worker writes only the two levels the log reader admits from a worker.
A log grown to the largest size allowed is rolled over before the next write.
A roll is renamed from the highest number downward.
The roll that would exceed the count kept is dropped.
The log file takes the name the daemon page gives rather than a name written again here.
A failure to write the log leaves the worker running.
A line reaches the terminal only where the worker runs attached to a terminal.

definition: how the watcher worker writes its log and rolls the log over once it grows large
